corrections: singleton+10h is NOT one 4096-entry table. It is two 2048-entry arrays: +10h forward (Type -> class index) and +2010h inverse (class index -> Type). 2010h-10h and 4010h-2010h are each 2000h bytes = 800h ints.

MDestroyer is not the only recovered class name; all 22 are recovered.
00964790 also WRITES back into the Lua row: row.ID = classIndex (00CE59B4) and row.Got = true (00CE452C). Neither key is authored in the shipped file.
